_doc: Tier-Letter score cutoffs for /tft/units, /tft/items, /tft/comps. The Helper in app/lib/tft-tier-letter.ts reads `default` if no set-specific block is present. Cutoffs calibrated against public/tft-stats-euw1.json so the live snapshot lands ~10/15/25/30/20% across S/A/B/C/D. Re-calibrate after each set drop. minGames keeps low-sample noise out of the badge — `null` is shown instead.
